NOW: Anti-corruption groups and other progressive formations led by Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (BAYAN) gather at Pedro Gil corner Taft Avenue to denounce the ghost flood control projects under the Marcos Jr. administration.

Groups demand accountability over the worsening flooding crisis across the country.
